plugin.name: ob-switcher
plugin._long: fast-switcher behavior plus a labwc-style window-switcher OSD themed by themerc osd.* keys.

option.name: activate
option._long: Open/step the switcher forward. Hold the modifier and press again to step; release to select. Alt+Tab (labwc default) — super+Tab belongs to the stock fast-switcher.

option.name: activate_backward
option._long: Open/step the switcher in the opposite direction.

option.name: inactive_alpha
option._long: Opacity of the non-selected windows while the switcher is open (1.0 disables dimming).

option.name: osd_show
option._long: Show the labwc-style window list OSD while switching.
